key_insight: Four 80 cm superconducting interconnects linked two 120-qubit processors, enabling high-fidelity state transfer and cross-module entangling gates.
engineering_relevance: Perpendicular cable installation and post-mount indium bonding offer a practical route toward denser connections between modular quantum processors.
method: Connect lattice qubits through frequency-tunable L-qubits, RF-SQUID couplers, and superconducting aluminum coax.
Use interconnect modes near 5 GHz for relay-based quantum state transfer.
Implement distant CZ gates and generate simultaneous Bell pairs over two adjacent links.
evidence_signal: Across four links, mean state-transfer fidelity was 99.00% and mean distant-CZ fidelity was 94.75%; best-link results were 99.29 ± 0.07% and 96.42 ± 0.28%, respectively.
watch_item: Scaling beyond four links remains unproven, and cross-module CZ fidelity trails state-transfer fidelity.
paper_title: Meter-scale quantum interconnects between large quantum processors
